notes: No kb/Work note owns the fix (none found for the phrase order at 85). §1985:IX.4.7.2 prints START file-name-1 [ KEY { IS EQUAL TO | IS = | IS GREATER THAN | IS > | IS NOT LESS THAN | IS NOT < | IS GREATER THAN OR EQUAL TO | IS >= } data-name-1 ] [ INVALID KEY imperative-statement-1 ] [ NOT INVALID KEY imperative-statement-2 ] [ END-START ]. startStatement / startKeyPhrase parse it (KEY, then a required comparisonOperator, then data-name-1) and BindStart binds it, mapping the operator through MapOperator and taking EQUAL when the KEY phrase is omitted (§1985:IX.4.7.4 GR2). The operator set is cut to the 1985 eight at --std 85: VisitStartKeyPhrase refuses LESS, <, NOT GREATER, NOT >, LESS OR EQUAL and <= (COBOL0900, start-reverse-operators-2002), BindStart refuses NOT EQUAL and NOT = (COBOL0862), VisitComparisonOperator refuses <> (COBOL0900), and the grammar has no NOT >=. FIRST and LAST (VisitStartStatement) and WITH LENGTH (VisitStartWithLength) are COBOL0900 at 85; KEY with no operator, a literal operand and an AT END phrase are syntax errors. Probed at 85: all eight printed operators, with and without the optional words IS, THAN, TO and KEY, compile and run. What is NOT implemented is the printed sequence of the two phrases: the conditionalPhrases loop and ConditionalPhraseAssociation.Associates / MayAssociate have no edition arm for the order, so NOT INVALID KEY before INVALID KEY compiles at 85; either order is the 2002 change §2002:F.2 item 33 ("The conditional phrases in the ... START ... statements may be specified in any order"), which the row's change record names. Same mechanism as the DELETE, READ, REWRITE and WRITE rows of this slice. The witness runs EQUAL TO, >= and GREATER THAN in the printed phrase order with END-START.

next.reason: 1985 indexed START: START file-name-1 [KEY {IS EQUAL TO | = | GREATER | > | NOT LESS | NOT < | GREATER OR EQUAL | >=} data-name-1] [INVALID KEY] [NOT INVALID KEY] [END-START]. §2023:14.9.41.2 adds FIRST, LAST, record-key-name-1 and WITH LENGTH arithmetic-expression-1, and lets the INVALID KEY phrases appear in either order; §2023:14.9.41.3 SR3 admits any relational operator of the general relation "with the exception of the relational operators 'IS NOT EQUAL TO' or 'IS NOT='", i.e. the §2023:8.7.5.1 set including LESS, NOT GREATER and LESS OR EQUAL. 1985 STARTs keep their meaning. §2023:14.9.41.4 GR9 does not belong: it speaks of the "relative record number" and governs relative files.
